scripts.dev: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix desktop && concurrently -k -n web,app -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run dev --prefix desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix desktop && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm run build --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix desktop
scripts.start: npm run build && node desktop/scripts/launch.mjs production
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node desktop/scripts/launch.mjs smoke
